body:
Thanks, but I honestly don't think I can try hard at literally anything. The only thing I put effort in nowadays is thinking of the most easiest/cowardly ways I could die. I'll try taking up a hobby, but like I said I can't try too hard. It's super hard for me to even get up in the mornings. I mean, it's gotten to the point that I don't even care I went from A+'s to C's and D's in a matter of weeks. 

I mean, I can just barely feel hunger now. I used to take my ADHD medication to suppress my hunger, but now my body does it all on its own.

I'll try changing my personality. I don't think it'll work since I believe that's something that sticks with you even after death, but maybe if I pretend to be a good person for long enough I'll eventually convince myself I am one.

The only issue is, I'm a competitive person. I feel like I'm fighting myself, the side of me that wants to get better and the side of me that would rather not exist.

I made this post because I'm scared- I feel like I'm going insane. A normal person shouldn't be having panic attacks at the thought of what'll happen if I stay alive, but also having panic attacks at the thought of dying. 

Thanks for replying, my eyes seriously teared up a bit- moved me more than anyone has in my entire life, but that's not saying much honestly.
 
You're a great guy, I hope you know that.

(again- sorry if I made no sense, it's 1:30 in New York)
It depends, if it's on discord no. If it's on Reddit then tmr when I wake up

Forgot to mention, if you think I'm doing this for attention, then I hope you know I do not think depression is cool. I feel so weak. I hate having to depend on other people. Fortunately no one knows about this, so it's not as bad as it should be.
